lastTask: Add prompt-based song starter composer to the song library slice

projectState.summary: Song Library slice is implemented on codex/byte-song-library-a with a prompt-based starter composer. New song now opens a modal that collects an overall song direction, optional tonic/mode/tempo/form overrides, selectable player plans, and per-player briefs. The prompt is interpreted through the existing deterministic SongGoal vocabulary/validator, the validated setup is applied through applySongGoalSetup(), and starter metadata is stored on the song library entry. The old Lantern/Switchback/Glass materials remain hidden starter templates underneath for compatibility and in-scale playback, and each library song has isolated editor/evolving branches. Player plan checkboxes are metadata-only in this slice; actual transport roster inclusion/exclusion is a future scheduling byte. Validation: npm run build, npm run smoke (78/78), npm run db:smoke, git diff --check all green; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisories.
